title: Consistency of Stage Queries
statement: Let $(N_i)_{i\ge 0}$ be a sequence of finite-state oracle Turing machines, and let $S_i$ be the finite set of positive strings at stage $i$. Use the stage-$i$ oracle whose language is $S_i$, and run $N_i$ on the unary input of length $n_i$, where $n_i$ is the fresh length chosen for stage $i$ and its current bound; let $Q_i$ be the list of query strings it makes during the first $n_i^i+i$ steps. Every $z\in Q_i$ belongs to $S_i$ if and only if it belongs to $S_j$ for some stage $j$.
